outcome: Weight change in the first month after birth
cohort: 143,889 singleton neonates born at or after 36 weeks gestation weighing 2000-5000g at birth, delivered at Kaiser Permanente Northern California Medical Centers between 2009 and 2013.
finding: A larger percentage of newborns delivered by Caesarean section had yet to regain birth weight at every time point through 1 month.
mod_finding: A larger percentage of newborns delivered by Caesarean section had yet to regain birth weight at every time point through 1 month.
